tldr: 台股18日重挫549點收45,309點，台積電尾盤遭殺；惟AI記憶體與光通訊族群逆勢抗跌。
台灣半導體「五虎將」9月2日將登SEMICON舞台，法人看好下半年AI收穫期帶動供應鏈。
金管會推10月金融科技四大活動，金融就業金卡累計破千張，亞資中心搶才升溫。

items.title_zh: 台股重挫549點失守45.5K 台積電尾盤遭殺
items.title_en: TAIEX tumbles 549 points as TSMC hit by late sell-off
items.summary_zh: 台股18日終場下跌548.59點、跌幅1.2%，收45,308.68點，成交量約9,584億元；早盤一度漲逾200點，獲利了結賣壓湧現使指數翻黑，盤中高低震盪達839點。台積電最後一盤爆出約4千張賣壓、下跌20元收2,380元，拖累權值股走弱，市場氣氛轉趨保守。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark TAIEX fell 548.59 points, or 1.2%, to close at 45,308.68 on Tuesday, with turnover around NT$958 billion. The index swung 839 points intraday after an early gain of over 200 points evaporated amid profit-taking. TSMC dropped NT$20, or 0.83%, to NT$2,380 after roughly 4,000 lots hit the closing auction, dragging heavyweight peers lower.

items.title_zh: 資金聚焦AI基建 記憶體、光通訊逆勢抗跌
items.title_en: AI hardware bucks the sell-off as memory and optical names rally
items.summary_zh: 儘管大盤重挫，資金仍聚焦AI基礎建設，記憶體與光通訊族群逆勢走強，成為盤面少數亮點。賣壓集中於大型科技權值股，聯發科跌4.07%收3,885元、台達電跌3.45%、鴻海跌2.35%；美債殖利率反彈與地緣政治疑慮升溫壓抑買氣。法人研判台股短線維持高檔震盪整理格局。
items.summary_en: Despite the broad decline, funds stayed focused on AI infrastructure, with memory and optical-communication stocks outperforming and cushioning the index. Selling pressure centred on large-cap tech — MediaTek fell 4.07% to NT$3,885, Delta Electronics dropped 3.45% and Hon Hai lost 2.35% — as investors weighed rebounding U.S. Treasury yields and renewed geopolitical worries. Analysts expect the TAIEX to keep consolidating at elevated levels.

items.title_en: Taiwan's 'AI five tigers' to headline SEMICON Taiwan 2026 forum
items.summary_zh: SEMICON Taiwan 2026大師論壇暨全球生態系高峰會將於9月2日登場，集結台灣AI供應鏈「五虎將」——日月光、台積電、聯發科、鴻海與欣興，串起IC設計、晶圓製造、先進封裝、IC載板及AI伺服器五大環節。此陣容凸顯台灣半導體聚落正圍繞AI需求緊密整合，持續強化在全球供應鏈的話語權。
items.summary_en: SEMICON Taiwan 2026's master forum and global ecosystem summit on Sept 2 will bring together leaders of Taiwan's AI supply-chain "five tigers" — ASE, TSMC, MediaTek, Hon Hai and Unimicron — spanning IC design, wafer fabrication, advanced packaging, IC substrates and AI servers. The line-up underscores how tightly Taiwan's chip cluster is integrating around AI demand across the full manufacturing chain.

items.title_zh: 下半年AI大變現 台灣供應鏈迎收穫期
items.title_en: Analysts see H2 AI 'harvest' lifting Taiwan supply chain
items.summary_zh: 路博邁點名下半年AI落地加速下的五大關鍵科技，指CPU對GPU比例朝1:1演進，帶動處理器需求倍增，預估DRAM年複合成長率達89%。先進封裝產能滿載，外溢訂單直接嘉惠台灣封測大廠，並拉動12吋矽晶圓擴產與用量，供應鏈可望進入業績收穫期。
items.summary_en: Neuberger Berman flagged five key technologies as AI deployment scales in the second half, with the CPU-to-GPU ratio moving toward 1:1 and lifting processor demand sharply; it projects DRAM to grow at an 89% CAGR. With advanced-packaging capacity fully booked, overflow orders are benefiting Taiwan's OSAT firms and driving expansion in 12-inch wafer output.

items.title_zh: 金管會推金融科技四大活動 台北金融科技展10/23登場
items.title_en: FSC unveils four fintech events, Taipei expo set for Oct 23
items.summary_zh: 金管會宣布以「區塊鏈金融與人工智慧」為主軸的四大重點活動，透過政策引導及跨域合作，促進新興科技於金融領域的創新應用。「台北金融科技展」將於10月23至24日舉行，國際論壇10月23日登場。此舉顯示監理機關積極加速金融業導入新興科技、深化數位轉型。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission announced four flagship fintech initiatives centred on blockchain finance and AI, aiming to spur innovation through policy guidance and cross-sector collaboration. The Taipei FinTech Expo runs Oct 23-24, with an international forum on Oct 23. The push reflects regulators' effort to accelerate adoption of emerging technologies across the financial sector.

items.title_zh: 金融就業金卡累計破千張 亞資中心搶才升溫
items.title_en: Financial 'gold cards' top 1,000 as Taiwan courts talent
items.summary_zh: 截至7月底，金融領域就業金卡累計核發達1,026張、首度突破千張；光今年前7月就核發113張，全年有望逼近2021年198張的高峰。核發加速反映政府推動亞洲資產管理中心、積極延攬跨境金融專業人才的政策成效，也為金融業引入更多國際化人力。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's employment gold cards for the financial sector surpassed 1,000 cumulatively by end-July, with 113 issued in the first seven months of 2026 alone — putting the full-year total on track to approach the 2021 peak of 198. The acceleration supports Taiwan's push to build an Asian asset-management hub by attracting cross-border financial professionals.

items.title_zh: 滙豐聚焦五大財管策略 推保費融資搶高資產
items.title_en: HSBC targets high-net-worth clients with premium financing
items.summary_zh: 滙豐（台灣）定位為市場唯一具全球布局的專業財管銀行，聚焦五大財富管理業務策略，並新推保費融資商品，滿足高資產客戶在資產配置與傳承保障上的需求。此舉凸顯銀行業競相搶攻台灣快速擴張的高淨值客群，財管商品與服務的競爭持續升溫。
items.summary_en: HSBC Taiwan, positioning itself as the market's only globally-oriented professional wealth-management bank, is sharpening five core wealth strategies and rolling out premium financing (insurance-premium lending) to serve high-net-worth clients' needs for asset allocation and succession planning. The move highlights intensifying competition among banks for Taiwan's fast-growing pool of wealthy investors.

items.title_zh: 亞資高峰論壇 銀行看好私募市場與家族辦公室
items.title_en: Banks eye private markets and family offices at Asia wealth forum
items.summary_zh: 2026亞資高峰論壇上，銀行業看好私募市場與家族辦公室商機，呼籲擴大另類資產布局、深化跨境財富管理服務。與會者認為，此與台灣打造亞洲資產管理中心的目標一致；隨高資產客戶對信託、另類投資與傳承規劃需求攀升，跨境財管與家辦服務可望成為下一波成長動能。
items.summary_en: At the 2026 Asian asset-management hub forum, bankers voiced optimism on private markets and family offices, urging wider allocation to alternative assets and deeper cross-border wealth-management services. The discussion aligns with Taiwan's ambition to grow as a regional hub, as high-net-worth demand for trusts, alternatives and succession planning continues to climb.
